```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::ParquetFileReader$create("data/history.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
#| label: history-schema

markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0))

nrow(joined)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

# Inspect column types
glimpse(groups)
glimpse(market_groups)

# Inspect example values
head(groups, 5)
head(market_groups, 5)

# Check row counts
nrow(groups)
nrow(market_groups)

# Compare column names with markets
intersect(names(markets), names(market_groups))
intersect(names(groups), names(market_groups))
```
